TWO ROOTS. ONE BEAUTIFUL JOURNEY.

The mountains brought us home.

From the beautiful hills of Darjeeling to the mountains of Kumaon, we grew up in two different worlds, each with its own stories, traditions and little joys. Life brought us together in Delhi, where two paths crossed, hearts connected, and we found a home in each other.

With the love and blessings of our families, we’re now bringing our worlds together to create a new one of our own, filled with love, laughter and the best of both our cultures.

Two roots, two stories, one beautiful forever.

Rohit Singh
Nainital
Simran Gurung
Darjeeling
